semiconductor_relevance: High — MRM Co., Ltd specializes in high-purity chemical liquid valves and fluid control systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: MRM Co., Ltd manufactures and sells high-purity chemical liquid valves designed for fluid control in semiconductor manufacturing environments. Their products are customizable and made from corrosion-resistant materials, ensuring safety and reliability when handling various chemicals.
capabilities: Customization of valve sizes and materials

regional_presence.Asia: MRM has established offices and distributors across Asia, including China, South Korea, Taiwan, and Singapore, providing local support.
